evidence.quote: Because this research was investigating evolution of γ′ within LSHR, precipitate size and volume measurements and chemical compositions were conducted only on the LSHR side of the weld.

The two materials were successfully joined at the Edison Welding Institute using an MTI model 120 IFW machine with the following parameters: 0.379 kg m2 moment of inertia, 346 rad/s initial angular speed, 55.2 kN axial force, resulting in an initial kinetic energy of 22.6 kJ.
The IFW process dissolved all original γ′ near the interface, but did not dissolve grain boundary primary γ′ at distances beyond 100 μm.

Ordered reflections clearly indicate the presence of γ′ precipitates.

prior to welding LSHR had a fine-grained duplex microstructure consisting of equiaxed γ grains, primary γ′ particles, and carbide particles. The average feature diameters were approximately 3.5, 1.3, and 0.7 μm, respectively.
The total volume fraction and primary volume fraction of γ′ were approximately 55%, and 35%, respectively.
The carbide volume fraction was approximately 1%.
The as-cast Mar-M247 material consisted of coarse-grained, dendritic γ grains larger than 1 mm in diameter
The alloy contained cuboidal shaped primary γ′ precipitates, approximately 1.25 μm in diameter, and a volume fraction of 64%.
